Consolidates plans prepared by Panchayats and Municipalities and prepares a development plan for the district.

items: Article 243ZD directly relates to the establishment and function of the District Planning Committee.
Note that the District Planning Committee integrates plans from both rural (Panchayats) and urban (Municipalities) local bodies.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Governed under Article 243ZD of the Constitution of India.
Consolidates development plans prepared by Panchayats and Municipalities.
Responsible for preparing a unified draft development plan for the district as a whole.
